fields.campaignInfo.campaignName: Arthur T Realty homeownership program: automated texts to Maryland clients who opted in on our website. Texts give each client their next program step (credit monitoring, mortgage application, Land Trust application, homeownership workshop, counseling), links to complete each step, appointment reminders, savings check-ins, and answers to their questions from our AI homeownership assistant.
fields.campaignInfo.optInWorkflow: Clients opt in on our website (https://main.d3c5zstiegwi2m.amplifyapp.com/quiz/ and the form on each service page). The form collects name, phone, and email and has an unchecked checkbox the client must check before submitting, labeled: "I agree to receive calls (including automated and AI-generated voice calls), texts, and emails from Arthur T Realty about real estate and homeownership services at the number and email provided. Message frequency varies. Message & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out of texts or HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase." The consent text, time, IP address, and browser are stored with each client record. SMS terms: https://main.d3c5zstiegwi2m.amplifyapp.com/sms-terms/ Clients who give consent in person or by phone are added by our staff in an internal dashboard, which requires a consent checkbox and records it; they receive the same opt-in confirmation text.
